title: Data and Evaluation
summary: This module provides comprehensive tools for managing datasets and evaluating the performance of DSPy programs. It includes utilities for loading, structuring, and splitting various datasets, as well as a rich collection of metrics for assessing language model responses, ranging from LLM-based auto-evaluation to traditional string-based comparisons.

nodes.label: Dataset Management & Loading
nodes.title: Dataset Management & Loading
nodes.description: Provides utilities for loading, managing, and splitting various datasets, including specialized loaders for AlfWorld, GSM8K, and MATH. It converts data into DSPy Example objects.

nodes.label: Evaluation Metrics
nodes.title: Evaluation Metrics Module
nodes.description: Offers a collection of metrics for evaluating language model responses, including LLM-based auto-evaluation for semantic understanding and traditional string/token-based comparison methods.

nodes.label: DSPy Program
nodes.title: DSPy Program
nodes.description: The core DSPy program or module whose performance is to be evaluated using the metrics and datasets provided by this module.

nodes.label: Raw Data Sources
nodes.title: External Data Sources
nodes.description: Various external sources like Hugging Face datasets, local files (CSV, JSON, Parquet), or Pandas DataFrames that provide raw data for DSPy datasets.

nodes.label: Language Model (LLM)
nodes.title: Underlying Language Model
nodes.description: The large language models that DSPy programs interact with, and whose responses are evaluated by the metrics in this module.

nodes.label: DSPy Example Object
nodes.title: DSPy Example
nodes.description: The fundamental data structure in DSPy, representing a single input-output example, used for both datasets and evaluation.

groups.label: Data Preparation
groups.title: Data Preparation & Management
groups.description: This group focuses on ingesting, structuring, and managing datasets from various sources, converting them into a format suitable for DSPy programs.

groups.label: Program Evaluation
groups.title: Program Evaluation & Metrics
groups.description: This group provides the tools and metrics necessary to assess the performance and quality of DSPy programs and their language model outputs.

groups.label: Core Entities & External Systems
groups.title: Core Entities & External Systems
groups.description: Represents the central DSPy program, external data inputs, the underlying language models, and the standardized DSPy Example objects that tie the data and evaluation processes together.
